items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: my first job was through Buddy Gilmore on Long Island... So essentially, you were subbing for Buddy Gilmore. Yeah. I mean drumming.

ctx.x: About how old was he? Was he much older than you?

Yeah, he was older than I am. He must have been round about...probably 28 or 29 years old, I guess he was. Of course, I was way younger than that... [IF MR. MOORE WAS BORN IN 1900, HE WAS 28 OR 29 WHEN HE MET BUDDY GILMORE]
